title: the recovery device's proofs run the host's bash, not the bare word bash
intention: Every recovery proof builds its bash argv from the host's bash (shutil.which on Windows), and an AST door proof over cairn/devices/recovery/proofs holds that no argv list starts with the bare word bash.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: git grep for a list literal headed by bash in cairn/devices/recovery found five sites: test_bootstrap.py:96, test_instance_wiring_links_every_verb.py:95, test_launchers_moved_to_their_devices.py:72,74,83
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: a proof that runs another OS's shell on a box measures that shell, not the component; Law 4: held by a scan.
how: In the three proofs add a module _BASH that is shutil.which('bash') on nt and 'bash' elsewhere and use it as the argv head at the five sites. Add cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_no_recovery_proof_spawns_a_bare_bash.py, an AST scan of the recovery proofs for a Call whose first argument is a list headed by the string bash. Other reds in these proofs are other causes and are left alone.

clauses.claim: an AST scan of cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_*.py finds no Call whose first argument is a list headed by the string bash
the three edited proofs get past their bash spawns on Windows without running WSL's bash

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

orient.request: Run the recovery proofs' bash under the host's bash: cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_bootstrap.py:96, cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_instance_wiring_links_every_verb.py:95 and cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_launchers_moved_to_their_devices.py:72,74,83 spawn the bare word bash (WSL launcher); see cairn/tools/base/script_argv.py
